# Bolus

Bolus is a mobile anesthesia record app for office-based and procedural sedation workflows.

It helps anesthesia providers document pre-op, intra-op, and recovery information, then export a clean PDF anesthesia record.

Bolus is designed for anesthesiologists, CRNAs, dentist anesthesiologists, oral surgeons, and clinicians performing office-based anesthesia or sedation.

Core topics:
- Mobile anesthesia charting
- Office-based anesthesia documentation
- Dental anesthesia records
- Sedation recordkeeping
- Paper anesthesia chart alternatives
- Local-first clinical documentation
- Secure PDF anesthesia record export
